title.zh: 推理 Infra 可视化课程

description.zh: 从一个 token 到多卡部署，用可单步执行的模拟器讲清 vLLM 和 SGLang 的核心机制：KV cache 与连续批处理、PagedAttention、前缀缓存、引擎架构、约束解码、加速手段、分布式部署，以及 Agent 负载对推理 infra 的新要求。最后一课附压测脚本，可以在自己的机器上跑出真实曲线。
description.en: From a single token to multi-GPU serving: step-through simulators that explain the core mechanisms of vLLM and SGLang — KV cache and continuous batching, PagedAttention, prefix caching, engine architecture, constrained decoding, acceleration, distributed serving, and what agent workloads ask of inference infra. The last lesson ships a benchmark kit so you can measure real curves on your own hardware. (Lessons are in Chinese.)

note.zh: 每一课都是可交互的页面：单步执行模拟器、调参数、先预测再看结果。图里的耗时来自一个简化的成本模型，数量级合理但不是实测值；第 9 课可以换成你自己机器上的数据。
note.en: Every lesson is an interactive page: step through the simulators, tweak parameters, predict before you reveal. Timings come from a simplified cost model — the right order of magnitude, not measurements; lesson 9 swaps in numbers from your own machine.
